components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Stamp-solid terracotta action; the one true action per context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.44 0.125 35); color: oklch(0.985 0.012 35); border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.48 0.125 35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.62 0.11 35); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.11 35 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Ruled paper control; the default quiet voice.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: oklch(0.995 0.004 35); color: oklch(0.16 0.01 35); border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.01 35); border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.962 0.012 35); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.62 0.11 35); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.11 35 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Ruled-line field; focus turns the line terracotta.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Fuzzy search by code, name, contents, or cost..." />
components.css: .ds-input { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.16 0.01 35); border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.01 35); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; width: 100%; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.45 0.02 35); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.62 0.11 35); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.11 35 / 0.5); }

narrative.overview: A well-kept working ledger at a clinic bench: warm paper, stamp-red ink for what matters, ruled lines that never waver. The system pairs hospitality warmth (terracotta on cream, 35° hue throughout) with clinical precision (mono-spaced data, aligned grids, one frosted control strip). Everything is flat and ruled except the single lifted data panel — the ledger's working surface. Blue appears only to carry information the ledger itself doesn't own: disclaimers and provenance.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (Kiln Terracotta) owns wayfinding and interaction; it is rare by design
All identifiers and prices are mono, tabular, 13px
Flat surfaces, 1px ruled lines, one lifted panel with a soft shadow
Frosted sticky control strip on the table (backdrop-blur over warm mute)
Dark mode is the same ledger at night: warm near-black paper, lifted cards, glowing terracotta

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only accent. On any screen it covers roughly 10% or less — its rarity is what makes wayfinding read instantly.

rules.name: The Informational Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue carries facts the ledger doesn't own (disclaimers, provenance, "Single Test" semantics). Blue is never decoration, never interaction.

rules.name: The Data Voice Rule
rules.body: Codes and prices are always mono and always tabular — never Hanken, never proportional figures. It is how the ledger signals "this is measured fact."

rules.name: The One Lifted Object Rule
rules.body: Exactly one element per page may carry a shadow: the table panel. Everything else is flat paper separated by ledger lines.

dos: Do keep every identifier and price in Geist Mono, tabular, 13px.
Do reserve terracotta for wayfinding and interaction; when in doubt, leave it out.
Do keep hue 35 across all neutrals — even borders and mutes are warm.
Do top-align table cells so rows scan on one line.
Do keep the disclaimer banner and its links visible and denim-tinted (binding product commitment).
donts: Don't introduce gradients, colored card edges, background stripes, or glass effects — the ledger is ruled paper, not a screen saver.
Don't use blue for interaction or decoration; blue is information only.
Don't shadow anything except the data panel.
Don't fabricate data claims, dates, or testimonials in any visual treatment.
Don't center-align multi-line table rows or dilute the contents column — it is the payload and takes the dominant share.
